name: How long does foreclosed property painting usually take?
description: Timing depends on prep and repairs. Small jobs may finish quickly, but damaged foreclosures usually take longer than standard painting.

mainEntity.name: How long does foreclosed property painting usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most delays come from hidden damage, bad weather on exterior jobs, or unclear access to the property. In the Denver metro area, scheduling can also depend on how quickly the property is cleared and whether multiple trades need to finish before painting starts.
